prompt.project_info: Create a realistic close-up portrait of an original approved adult man leaning against a sunlit stucco wall.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult man with a rugged jawline, short messy textured brown hair, calm direct gaze, and natural skin texture wears a simple high-quality white cotton T-shirt with rolled sleeves. Preserve the original adult identity only when an approved reference is attached; do not imitate a celebrity or public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up portrait from chest upward, subject leaning against a white stucco wall, sharp focus on eyes and facial structure, visible white cotton weave and muscular but natural upper-arm silhouette, ample clean negative space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic golden-hour sunlight from the side creates deep wall and facial shadows with warm earthy highlights, natural contrast, quiet effortless masculine mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic 35mm lens perspective at approximately f/1.8, close portrait framing, shallow depth of field, hyper-realistic natural skin pores, subtle sensor grain, restrained warm color grade, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic close-up portrait of an original approved adult man with a rugged jawline, short messy textured brown hair, calm direct gaze, and natural skin texture leaning against a sunlit white stucco wall. He wears a simple high-quality white cotton T-shirt with rolled sleeves. Sharp focus on eyes and facial structure, visible cotton weave, natural upper-arm silhouette, dramatic golden-hour sunlight creating deep shadows and warm earthy highlights, 35mm lens at approximately f/1.8, shallow depth of field, subtle grain, effortless masculine lifestyle mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, distorted face

assets.usage: Match the original adult model's general facial structure, hair, white T-shirt, stucco wall, pose, and golden-hour light without celebrity likeness.
